+    def test_pairplot_column_multiindex(self):
+
+        # Test that pairplot works with MultiIndex columns
+        data = {
+            ("A", "1"): np.random.rand(10),
+            ("A", "2"): np.random.rand(10),
+            ("B", "1"): np.random.rand(10),
+            ("B", "2"): np.random.rand(10),
+        }
+        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
+        
+        # Create PairGrid with MultiIndex columns
+        g = ag.PairGrid(df)
+        
+        # Verify that diag_vars are tuples (not converted to arrays)
+        assert g.diag_vars is None  # Not set until map_diag is called
+        
+        # Map diag with a simple function to avoid pandas version issues
+        def simple_plot(x, **kwargs):
+            ax = kwargs.get('ax')
+            if ax is not None:
+                ax.hist(x, bins=5)
+        
+        g.map_diag(simple_plot)
+        
+        # Verify that diag_vars are tuples (not converted to arrays)
+        assert len(g.diag_vars) == 4
+        for var in g.diag_vars:
+            assert isinstance(var, tuple)
+        
+        # Verify that we can access the data with the tuple column names
+        for var in g.diag_vars:
+            assert var in df.columns
+            _ = df[var]  # This should not raise KeyError
+
